visible_deviations: Aspect ratio preserved within rounding. Open-reference cell has wider eyes than first open cell; first open reads as a softer, more squinted happy gaze. Eyelid/brow lines look darker and more defined than source, though not solid black. No compositing or cell sampling performed.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: one complete 2×2 NPC portrait upper-half eye expression sheet
Input images: Image 1 is the exact 2×2 upper-half layout, source geometry, and cell order. Image 2 is the immutable native 64×64 original, sole identity and palette reference.
Primary request: create one happy eye upper-half sheet, row-major: open / half blink / fully closed / open-reference.
Subject: same woman, same exact cropped upper face in each cell.
Style/medium: original soft muted pixel-art palette and natural low-contrast skin shading. Preserve the original coarse pixel structure and proportions. No hard contrast.
Composition/framing: reproduce Image 1's full 2×2 sheet, same aspect ratio, exact boundaries and complete upper halves. Do not crop or resize. Keep each eye at native original size and coordinates.
Lighting/mood: clearly warmer, friendlier happy gaze than neutral, with gently lifted outer eye corners and very subtle softened cheek lift. Expression feels kind and relaxed.
Constraints: preserve exact face/head geometry, hairline, brows, iris size, eye spacing, skin tone, shading and framing from Image 1 and Image 2. Use same happy expression in all four cells. Only eyelid phase varies: cell 1 eyes open with friendly raised outer corners; cell 2 upper lids cover about half the irises; cell 3 eyes fully shut with no iris or sclera visible; cell 4 repeats cell 1 exactly in intent. Keep brows softly expressive and consistent. Original gentle palette remains.
Avoid: full-face portrait, lower face/mouth, extra facial regions, enlarged or shifted eyes, shifted hairline, black hard cartoon brows, thick eyeliner, high-contrast shadows, sharpened edges, blur, smudging, airbrush, anatomy changes, text, labels, gutters, borders, missing cells.
